quotes.text: Took my second trip with Dave and I have to say this is the best way to have fun in south florida! We hit the bars and the beach and it was great! We we had a group of 9 and we had so much fun at whiskey creek, one of the girls had never seen the ocean do we went over the dunes and fixed that. Also got to cruise past the boat show which was INSANE! Would recommend!

Our trip with Pontoon Party in Fort Lauderdale was a blast!!! One of my favorite experiences in Ft. Lauderdale ever. Captain Josh and mate Allie made sure we had a great time. I would definitely recommend booking with them as I’m sure it’ll be a blast!!

We had an amazing time with Pontoon Party! Captain Joe was great! We will definitely book another trip soon! I highly recommend calling Pontoon Party for your next Lauderdale boat adventure - whether you are a local or a tourist!

The sunset wine cruise during the week was the best! I went on Thursday. A Thursday well spent for sure! We saw an amazing sunset, enjoyed great music and people. Highly recommend this to anyone visiting Fort Lauderdale!

The best experience! Ask to have TJ if you have the opportunity. He made our experience 10/10, he had so many fun facts on the cruising portion and kept our drinks full the the vibes high at the sandbar.
AMAZING DAY!!!! CAPTIN DAVE WAS PHENOMENAL AND REALLY RESPONSIVE BEFORE THE TRIP. I would definitely book with this company again! Such a great time! CHOOSE CAPTIN DAVE AND TIP HIM WELL!
